26+Years Gathering Women
Welcome

A gathering for every woman called for such a time as this.

The AOH Women's Convention brings together women of the Apostolic Overcoming Holy Church of God from across the country for three days of worship, teaching, and sisterhood. This year we gather in Dayton, Ohio — a city of new beginnings — to be empowered, equipped, and encouraged for the work ahead.

Whether you're a first-time guest or a lifelong member, you'll find anointed teaching, real fellowship, and space to hear from God about your next season.

Good to Know

Frequently asked questions

What's included in my registration?+

Your registration includes all general sessions, workshops, the Thursday welcome reception, and the closing Saturday luncheon.

Is there a group discount for my church?+

Yes — groups of 5 or more receive a discounted rate. Select "Group of 5+" on the registration form and our team will follow up with details.

What hotel should I book?+

See the Hotel & Travel section above for our host hotel and group rate. Full booking details will be posted closer to the convention.

Can I get a refund if my plans change?+

Registrations are refundable up to 14 days before the convention. After that, we're happy to transfer your registration to another attendee.

What should I wear?+

Daytime sessions are comfortable and casual; many women dress up for the Thursday and Friday evening worship services.
